ex.en: Scientists are studying the diet and habits that contribute to human longevity.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究有助于人类长寿的饮食和习惯。

words.note: 常与 increase、extend 搭配，指长寿或事物的持久。

ex.en: He served in the military for ten years before entering politics.
ex.zh: 他从政前在军队服役十年。

words.note: 作名词指军队，多用 the military；作定语修饰名词。

ex.en: The city has a dynamic economy that attracts young graduates.
ex.zh: 这座城市经济充满活力，吸引着年轻毕业生。

words.note: 强调有活力、不断变化，与 static（静态的）相对。

ex.en: She hung her coat in the wardrobe and went downstairs.
ex.zh: 她把外套挂进衣柜，然后下了楼。

words.note: 指衣柜，也可指一个人的全部衣物，别与 clothes 混用。

ex.en: Many students are reluctant to speak English in front of the class.
ex.zh: 许多学生不愿在全班同学面前说英语。

words.note: 后接 to do，不接 doing；近义词 unwilling。

ex.en: She is a conscientious student who checks every answer twice.
ex.zh: 她是个认真的学生，每道题的答案都检查两遍。

words.note: 源于 conscience（良心），形容勤勉尽责、一丝不苟。

ex.en: His passion for music began when he was a child.
ex.zh: 他对音乐的热爱始于童年。

words.note: passion for sth 表热爱；复数 passions 指强烈情感。

ex.en: The new plant can generate enough electricity for the whole town.
ex.zh: 新电厂发的电足够全镇使用。

words.note: 多接 power、income、interest 等宾语，表“产生”。

ex.en: Extreme weather has become more frequent in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来极端天气越来越频繁。

words.note: go to extremes 走极端；常修饰 weather、measures。

ex.en: She tucked the letter into her pocket and left quickly.
ex.zh: 她把信塞进口袋，快步离开了。

words.note: 核心义“塞、掖”；tuck in 还可口语指“大吃一顿”。

ex.en: The report is based on authoritative sources such as official statistics.
ex.zh: 这份报告依据官方统计等权威来源。

words.note: 由 authority 变来，既指权威可信，也指专断。

ex.en: The young athlete trains six hours a day for the national games.
ex.zh: 这名年轻运动员为全国运动会每天训练六小时。

words.note: 指田径等运动员；形容词 athletic 表“运动的”。

ex.en: Please sit upright and keep your back against the chair.
ex.zh: 请坐直，让背部靠住椅背。

words.note: 指身姿挺直，也可形容人正直；常与 sit、stand 连用。

ex.en: Researchers managed to extract useful data from the old records.
ex.zh: 研究人员从旧档案中提取出了有用的数据。

words.note: 名词重音在前，指摘录或提取物；动词重音在后。

ex.en: The meaning of the poem remains obscure to most readers.
ex.zh: 这首诗的含义对多数读者来说仍然晦涩。

words.note: 兼指不出名和难懂；作动词表“遮掩、使模糊”。

ex.en: To her dismay, the train had already left when she arrived.
ex.zh: 让她沮丧的是，她赶到时火车已经开走了。

words.note: to one's dismay 是固定结构；dismayed 后接 at/by。

ex.en: They expended a great deal of effort on the experiment.
ex.zh: 他们在这个实验上花了大量精力。

words.note: 比 spend 正式，常接 energy、effort、resources。

ex.en: The two countries forged a close partnership over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年间，两国建立了紧密的合作关系。

words.note: 本义“锻造”，引申为“建立关系”和“伪造”。

ex.en: The teacher demonstrated how to use the new software step by step.
ex.zh: 老师一步步演示了如何使用新软件。

words.note: 既指演示、示范，也指论证、表明，后可接 that 从句。

ex.en: This region is famous for its tea and mild climate.
ex.zh: 这个地区以茶叶和温和的气候闻名。

words.note: in the region of 表“大约”；形容词为 regional。

ex.en: He was deceived by a false advertisement and lost a lot of money.
ex.zh: 他被一则虚假广告骗了，损失了很多钱。

words.note: 强调让人信假为真；deceive sb into doing 骗某人做。

ex.en: The magazine gave readers a preview of the new film.
ex.zh: 这本杂志向读者预告了新片的内容。

words.note: pre- 加 view，指放映或展出前的预览，也可作动词。

ex.en: The engineer came up with an ingenious way to save water.
ex.zh: 这位工程师想出了一个节水的巧妙办法。

words.note: 强调设计巧妙；别与 ingenuous（天真的）混淆。

ex.en: Two hundred students filled in the questionnaire about online study.
ex.zh: 两百名学生填写了关于线上学习的问卷。

words.note: 常用 fill in/out a questionnaire；指问卷表格本身。

ex.en: Scientists made a major breakthrough in cancer research last year.
ex.zh: 科学家去年在癌症研究上取得重大突破。

words.note: 常与 make、achieve 连用，后接介词 in。

ex.en: She had a quick snack before the meeting started.
ex.zh: 会议开始前她匆匆吃了点东西。

words.note: 指正餐之间的少量食物；snack bar 是小吃店。

ex.en: The farmers yoked the two oxen together to pull the cart.
ex.zh: 农夫把两头牛套在一起拉车。

words.note: 本义牛轭，引申为枷锁、束缚，常用 under the yoke of。

ex.en: The island has become a popular destination for young travellers.
ex.zh: 这座岛已成为年轻游客的热门目的地。

words.note: 指旅程终点；常与 reach、arrive at 连用。

ex.en: The young king came to the throne at the age of eighteen.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的国王十八岁登上王位。

words.note: come to/ascend the throne 表登基；也指宝座。

ex.en: Many users worry that the app may invade their privacy.
ex.zh: 许多用户担心这款应用会侵犯他们的隐私。

words.note: 不可数名词；常用 protect 或 invade one's privacy。
